title: Grateful Dead Live at Taft Auditorium on 1971-10-30
source: Recording of the FM Broadcast on WEBN Cincinnati, DAT provided and transferred by Stuccoholmes, Editing and Mastering by Jamie Waddell in Wavelab 7.1, Critical Listening assitance by John Wenzel. Track, FLAC and Pack by Norm

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Halloween show highlighted by an emotional 'Comes A Time' and a solid, though undocumented, recording quality
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the festive atmosphere—Halloween costumes, electric Kool‑Aid onstage—and Jerry’s powerful vocal delivery on 'Comes A Time,' even noting his pedal‑steel cameo with the New Riders. No technical flaws are mentioned, suggesting the audio is at least listenable and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and praised the performance and vibe; no recording complaints were noted, indicating both a strong show and acceptable sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments on clarity or mix; reviewers did not report any issues, implying the recording is generally satisfactory.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Details are sparse, but the night’s energy and festive mood were emphasized, with a memorable 'Comes A Time' performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for strong vocals on 'Comes A Time' and noted his pedal‑steel playing with the New Riders.
